name: ggml-speech
description: Speech-stack ggml flavour (tetherto/qvac-ext-ggml@speech), consumed by the speech-cpp port. This pin (PR #55) carries four OpenCL fixes keyed on tensor shape rather than on any one model, so every engine on Adreno gets them: ggml_cl_mul / div / sub no longer take the broadcast-row path on a non-contiguous src0 and then abort on a contiguity assert, kernel_pad gains a float4 flat-dispatch variant in place of one float per work-item on a 64-wide row group, the local-memory GEMM gate now tests M so a small-output-channel matmul stops running on a 64-row tile, and ARGMAX gains an OpenCL kernel (ties resolve to the largest index, matching ggml_vec_argmax_f32) instead of falling back. Also picks up a torch 2.6.0 bump in requirements.txt for CVE-2025-32434, which affects the Python conversion tooling only. CPU output is unchanged.

metal-fuse-mv-bias.description: Compile in the Q-variant mul_mv + ADD(bias) [+ ADD(residual)] fusion in ggml-metal. Off by default: empirically produces zero tokens on parakeet's EOU q8_0 joint network. Opt in only after Metal A/B-validating your model against the fused path.
